name: frontend-navigate
purpose: Past the storage dialog, try to actually LEAVE the front end. The mode-select page renders no item text (known atlas defect, C-450UB/UC), so this navigates blind on purpose: text legibility is not required to find out whether the game can enter a mode at all. Answers the top backlog question - is there a blocker between the front end and gameplay?

steps.name: clear-dialog
steps.purpose: Accept the storage dialog. Confirmed when the guest opens the device blade, which is the guest's own decision and therefore a real transition, not a guess.

steps.name: settle-modepage
steps.purpose: Let the mode-select page finish coming up before navigating it.

steps.name: select-mode
steps.purpose: Press A on whatever is focused. Blind by necessity - the item text does not render.

steps.name: nav-down
steps.purpose: Move the selection. DOWN is an EXTENDED key - without KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY the guest never sees it (iter-450V).

steps.name: nav-up-select
steps.purpose: And the other direction, in case the first item was the wrong one.

steps.name: observe-gameplay
steps.purpose: THE MEASUREMENT. Four minutes to see whether anything leaves the front end.
